description: D3 charts: cartesian, radial, statistical, hierarchical, networks, flows and maps; accessible legends, axes, tooltip and data.

howToUse: Use it to show numbers that change or compare: sales by month, share by channel, distribution of values.
Choose the chart by the question: line for time, bars to compare, pie only for parts of a whole with few slices.
Always set `title`, the axis titles (`yTitle`, `xTitle`) and `formatY` with the unit.
Offer the data as a table next to it when people need the exact values.
alternatives: One number with its trend: Stat.
Exact values to look up: Table.

keyboard.action: Moves between the points or bars, and reads the value.
Goes to the first or last point.

examples.label: LineChart
examples.description: Line chart with area: organic traffic over 90 days.
examples.code:
import { LineChart } from '@refy-design/web'; import type { ComponentProps } from 'react'; const traffic = [ 3200, 3600, 3400, 4800, 5200, 6100, 6800, 7400, 8600, 8900, 10200, 11400, ]; export function Example() { const args: Pick< ComponentProps, | 'title' | 'data' | 'xLabels' | 'pointLabels' | 'formatY' | 'yTitle' | 'xTitle' | 'label' > = { title: 'Organic traffic', data: traffic, xLabels: ['Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Today'], pointLabels: [ 'Wk 1', 'Wk 2', 'Wk 3', 'Wk 4', 'Wk 5', 'Wk 6', 'Wk 7', 'Wk 8', 'Wk 9', 'Wk 10', 'Wk 11', 'Wk 12', ], formatY: (v: number) => `${(v / 1000).toFixed(1)}k`, yTitle: 'Visits/month', xTitle: 'Last 90 days', label: 'Organic traffic (90 days)', }; return (
); }
